name: salesforce-mcp-server
description: Model Context Protocol server for Salesforce organizations — query and explore Salesforce data through standardized AI-accessible tools.

sfdc_client_id.title: Salesforce Client ID
sfdc_client_id.description: OAuth Connected App Client ID from your Salesforce org

sfdc_instance_url.title: Salesforce Instance URL
sfdc_instance_url.description: Your Salesforce org URL, e.g. https://myorg.my.salesforce.com

sfdc_client_secret.title: Salesforce Client Secret
sfdc_client_secret.description: OAuth Connected App Client Secret (leave blank if using PKCE-only flow)

sfdc_token_file.title: Token Storage File Path
sfdc_token_file.description: Absolute path where encrypted OAuth tokens will be persisted across sessions

mcp_log_file.title: Log File Path
mcp_log_file.description: Absolute path for the server log file (leave blank to disable file logging)

tools.name: soql_query
tools.description: Execute SOQL queries against Salesforce with pagination support and injection prevention

tools.name: sosl_search
tools.description: Perform SOSL searches across multiple Salesforce objects with result ranking

tools.name: validate_soql
tools.description: Validate SOQL syntax without execution, including security analysis

tools.name: explain_query_plan
tools.description: Get the query execution plan for a SOQL statement to aid optimization

tools.name: describe_object
tools.description: Get comprehensive object metadata and schema information for a Salesforce object

tools.name: list_objects
tools.description: List all available Salesforce objects (standard and custom) with optional filtering

tools.name: get_record
tools.description: Retrieve a specific Salesforce record by ID with configurable field selection

tools.name: get_picklist_values
tools.description: Get picklist values for specified fields, including dependencies and controlling fields

tools.name: get_org_limits
tools.description: Retrieve current org API limits and usage statistics

tools.name: get_user_info
tools.description: Get information about the currently authenticated Salesforce user

tools.name: get_recent_items
tools.description: Get recently viewed or modified items from the Salesforce org

tools.name: describe_layout
tools.description: Get page layout information for a Salesforce object
